name: Void Nexus
description: The Void Nexus is the absolute center of Akhevan void‑arcane cosmology. Here, raw void currents, resonance echoes, temporal fractures, and Luclinite stabilizers converge into a singular metaphysical core. The Nexus is forbidden to all but the highest Praesertum custodians, for even brief exposure can distort memory, identity, and temporal alignment.
